blockingIssues.description: Review found the feature incomplete: include_stale passive-observation behavior was lost, the targeted test change landed in a later unrelated commit, and the original always-include-passive search strategy was partially reverted in later code.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance that workers must keep `.factory/services.yaml`, `.factory/init.sh`, and `.factory/library/` edits isolated from unrelated bug-fix commits unless the feature explicitly requires shared-state updates.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The failed feature `fix-recall-grouping-regression` bundled recall logic changes with unrelated `.factory` shared-state edits, which made the fix harder to review and weakened commit atomicity.

rejectedObservations.observation: Various reviews noted that services.yaml, AGENTS.md, or library had no issues or already matched the current implementation.
Add shared test utilities for duplicated LIKE escape helpers.
Document broad capsule compaction internals in AGENTS.md.
